newsitem.title: ISRAEL: Israeli committee wants killer's shrine removed.
newsitem.headline: Israeli committee wants killer's shrine removed.

text.p: An Israeli parliamentary committee on Monday called for the destruction of a shrine erected by Jewish militants around the grave of a settler who gunned down 29 Palestinians at a Hebron mosque in 1994.

The tomb of Baruch Goldstein in Kiryat Arba settlement near Hebron in the occupied West Bank attracts admirers who pray and light candles for the U.S.-born doctor who massacred the Moslems as they kneeled in prayer at the burial place of the biblical patriarch Abraham, holy to Moslems and Jews.
Goldstein was beaten to death by survivors.

"The interior committee...calls on the army, the sovereign power in Kiryat Arba, to destroy the religious articles around the grave of the murderer Baruch Goldstein," the committee said in a statement.
The committee called on justice authorities charged with enforcing anti-incitement laws to find an alternative site for Goldstein's grave.
The well-tended tomb is in a broad plaza in the heart of Meir Kahane park, named after a militant rabbi who founded the anti-Arab Kach party. Kahane was assassinated in New York in 1990.

Prayer books and memorial candles are available to pilgrims to the tomb. An inscription on Goldstein's gravestone reads in part: "The holy Dr Baruch Goldstein...was killed while sanctifying the Name (of God)."
